🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 14, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds an opposition to Uranus, in Gemini. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. From Sagittarius, Moon concedes the point early. Cardinal fire: beginning costs almost nothing. Four weeks ago Mars was still in Cancer: the ground has moved.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Mercury faces you from Scorpio, holding the other figures. Fixed earth: the grip costs more than the thing. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Across from you in Sagittarius, Moon holds the other half of the account. Air adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Sagittarius, where nothing is owed to it. From Libra, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal water meets a bill. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Sun left Virgo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and something has to give way. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. A week ago Mercury was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon sextiles you from Sagittarius: a door left ajar. Air moves first here, and first is enough. The sextile to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Venus is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Water holds until owning and being coincide. The sextile of two weeks ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon sits inside your sign, and worth stops being an abstraction. Mutable fire: the alternatives turn out identical. Moon let go of it three weeks ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Sagittarius makes room for you, and then waits. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and the cost objects. Mutable water: every option kept is an option paid for. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.
